intersections.note: upper panel. W 6th jogs and changes direction at Evans (sloping WSW west of Evans, nearly level east of it); point is on the Evans centreline midway between the two W 6th centrelines. Corners: NW 4600,163; NE 4963,134; SE 4973,441; SW 4610,447

widths.note: printed 50' east of Evans (both panels); 55' west of Evans (upper panel)

bends.note: lower panel: W 6th turns from E-W to SE toward the wagon bridge
lower panel: turns ENE onto the Wagon Bridge over the Mill Creek; bridge continues off the right edge

ends.note: upper panel: Evans' faces stop at the C.C.C.&St.L. / B.&O.S.W. tracks; only the water pipe continues across the yard

notes: SPLIT SHEET: two separately framed panels divided by a heavy line at y ~4000. UPPER panel (y 0-4000, adjoins 463): W 6th from the left edge to Evans and on east to the right edge, Evans from W 6th south to the tracks, the C.C.C.&St.L. outbound freight house, B.&O.S.W. yard, turntable and roundhouse. LOWER panel (y 4000-7796, adjoins 464): the continuation of W 6th east of lot 1557 (lots 1555-1501, Mill Creek Distilling Co.) to the Wagon Bridge over the Mill Creek; the roundhouse at its lower left is the same one as the upper panel's right side. The lower panel has NO street intersections (only W 6th), so only its bends are recorded. BURNS ST. is printed at the upper panel's left edge, but the drawn line at x ~41 is Burns' EAST face (block corner with W 6th at 41,1315); the Burns centreline (45') would be at about x -95, off the sheet, so Burns/W 6th is not picked here (or on 463, where it falls just below the page).
